scenario.description: A Room Booking service manages reservations for hotel rooms and meeting rooms. The Reservation Repository stores a start instant and an end instant for each booking, and the Availability component must determine whether a proposed reservation overlaps an existing one. The rules permit one checkout at noon followed by another check-in at noon, so touching endpoints do not conflict, but a reservation from 14:00 to 16:00 conflicts with either neighboring booking. Some availability rules apply for the entire day, whereas others have no upper or lower limit because they represent agreements that have not yet been scheduled. Today, callers implement these checks independently using different strict and non-strict comparisons, and several use Long.MAX_VALUE or a distant date to mean an open end. This has produced both false conflicts for back-to-back reservations and false availability when an unbounded rule is clipped accidentally. The model must make endpoint inclusion, open ends, overlap, enclosure, and adjacency explicit and reusable without changing the persistent representation of timestamps.
scenario.decision_statement: Choose the value model that centralizes endpoint inclusion, unbounded ends, containment, overlap, and adjacency for reservation windows.
scenario.notes: range primary: endpoint inclusion, unbounded ends, and overlap and adjacency checks centralized for reservation windows; effectivity is the validity-period near-miss; dropped quantity support because no duration arithmetic is described.

residual_note: negative: per-call stage durations overlap (concurrent GENERATE batches), so the stage sum exceeds the measured wall clock; use the per-stage table, not this residual

selection.statement: How to model booking time intervals with explicit endpoint inclusion, open ends, overlap, enclosure and adjacency that is reusable without changing timestamp persistence.
alternatives: make-illegal-states-unrepresentable considered but discouraged in javascript; use Move the model to TypeScript and express it as a discriminated union on a literal tag (values that do not match a variant do not type-check), or keep JavaScript and run the TypeScript checker over JSDoc @typedef unions with // @ts-check; either way validate untrusted input at the boundary with a runtime schema (Zod, Valibot, Ajv) and let a single factory plus Object.freeze produce the variants, since JavaScript itself enforces nothing at run time.
